RULE-016.title: Edit employee: only salary or department can change, and the employee is found by ID alone
RULE-016.note: Right: keep edit-by-ID only, with no salary checks on edit and no name confirmation (as the code does today).

RULE-017.title: Admin login by matching ID and name (no password)
RULE-017.note: Right: keep ID + name login exactly as today, with no password.

RULE-018.title: Employee operations are not restricted to logged-in admins
RULE-018.note: Right: keep employee operations open, with no login required, as today.

RULE-014.title: Failed delete still sends the user to the home page as if it worked
RULE-014.note: Not wanted. The user asked: "Please give appropriet messages in case of error". A failed delete must show "Employee not found!".

RULE-025.title: Employee list shows an empty table when the employee data cannot be read
RULE-025.note: Not wanted. The user asked: "Please give appropriet messages in case of error". A read failure must show an error message, not an empty list.
